description: A nested menu whose sections open and close like tree branches, and a path line is drawn all the way to the selected option.
interactionNotes: Click a section's title to open or close its branches; whichever child is selected, a colored line is drawn from the trunk to that option and the indicator beside the title slides toward it. Section buttons have `aria-expanded` and closed children are out of the tab path, so it works correctly with the keyboard and screen readers too.

props.items: The sections. Each section has a `label` and a list of children (`value`, `label`, `icon`), or is itself a leaf with a `value`.
props.defaultOpen: Which sections are open at first. A negative number means none.
props.defaultActive: The initial selected value. Leave it empty so the first child of the open section is selected.
props.onSelect: Called when a child or a leaf is selected.
props.onToggle: Called when a section opens or closes.
props.color: Ink color. The lines and the unstyled text are blends of this same color.
props.accentColor: Color of the active line, the active label and the indicator.
props.lineColor: Color of the trunk and branches. It is a flat color so the connection points don't get darker.
props.width: Maximum menu width; it shrinks to fit the content.
props.indent: Where the children start. The branches end a little before it.
props.trunk: Horizontal position of the trunk line.
props.radius: Arc radius of each branch; it is limited to the row height.
props.fontSize: Font size of the children; section titles are one pixel larger.
props.drawDuration: Duration of drawing the active colored line, milliseconds.
props.foldDuration: Duration of each section opening and closing, milliseconds.
props.autoPreview: Site preview only: keeps the sections open and selects children one by one; every few steps a section actually folds and unfolds so the path line is drawn anew.
props.className: Extra class on the menu root.

tips: You can also give the colors with a CSS variable: `accentColor="var(--color-brand)"` so the active line matches your site's brand.
For a side menu, pass an array to `defaultOpen` so several sections are open at once.
Each child's icon is a React element (`icon`), so pass your own project's icons directly — there is no external dependency.
